input_evidence: Unchanged SHA-verified DEV-052B-FRESH1 checkpoints and original 512 held-out worlds; retrospective diagnostics, never fresh generalization
intervention_definition: Joint arm only; zero replaces current-fault probability and all repair-success probabilities with zero (sensor accuracy fixed .85); shuffle replaces the entire forecast vector with a deterministic permutation of intact decision-state forecasts, sampled sequentially per seed/cohort. Closed-loop native rollouts, charged physically. These are diagnostic destructive interventions, not deployable policies.
decision_log: All legal Q-values, chosen action, runner-up, top2 gap, oracle conditional forecast probabilities, learned forecast vector, and residual native trajectory. Reconstruct probability posterior using true generator rates and the actual public history, never hidden fault at inference.
forecast_quality: Expected Bernoulli log loss versus true conditional simulator probabilities, wait and all three service risks on the SAME intact decision states; report Bayes entropy and excess cross-entropy. Also realized-label log loss already archived. Exact probabilities available only to diagnostic evaluator.
statistical_unit: Paired worlds with crossed seed bootstrap: sample world clusters (stratify shifted families), sample initialization indices globally within each replicate; common controls/oracle paired with identical world draws. 2000 replicates, RNG5530001.
gap_metric: Retrospective fraction of observed oracle cost gap closed; undefined if denominator <=1e-9. Recompute numerator and denominator in each bootstrap; report denominator failure rate. No retrospective change to DEV052B registered success rule.
evidence_hash: Verify archive SHA256; record evidence Git SHA1, raw commit payload SHA256, canonical commit-object bytes SHA256, and original archive SHA256 with explicit byte definitions.
no_tuning: No checkpoint fitting, threshold modification, arm selection or original-result rewrite. Original excluded-split record retained. Audit shares author/code; no external independence claim.
